# QR Code generator library (C++)

Project Nayuki's QR Code generator, `qrcodegen.hpp` and `qrcodegen.cpp`, used unchanged for the Training phone remote's QR code.
Source: https://www.nayuki.io/page/qr-code-generator-library (MIT License, the notice is at the top of each file).
The upstream release is not recorded in the files: the header carries only the copyright line "Copyright (c) Project Nayuki. (MIT License)". The files were added to this repository on 2026-11-07 (commit a1855454f). The licence text is in `LICENSE.txt` and is packaged in `notices/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt`.
